title: Driving 1000 Miles in 3 Cars: Gas vs Electric!
summary: MKBHD drives a Tesla, a Mustang Mach-E and a gas car on a 1000-mile loop to compare total trip time and charging experience.
why: HN cites it as real-world evidence on EV road trip times and the unreliability of non-Tesla charging networks.

quote.text: When MKBHD tested a Tesla and a Mustang Mach-E, the Mach-E itself was fine but the charging infrastructure was unreliable.
